name: ui-swipe-actions-row
title: Swipe Actions Reveal
description: Ngón tay kéo một dòng sang trái, dòng bám đúng mốc −96 px để lộ hai nút thao tác phía sau sáng dần; chạm chỗ khác thì dòng đóng lại.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Three rows 240x40 r10. Middle row: finger drags x 0 → −70 over 0.35-0.85 s (power1.in), releases, row snaps to −96 over 0.85-1.49 s (640 ms) power2.out. Behind it two 48x40 action cells (blue, yellow) fade 0.3 → 1 with |x| / 96, clipped to the row. A tap elsewhere at 2.06 s closes it over 2.1-2.55 s power2.inOut. Finger ring visible only while dragging. Params: drag (70 px) · snap (−96 px, 0.64 s) · actions (2 × 48 px) · ease (power2.out). Dragged 70 units (power1.in), released, it snaps to −96 in 0.64 s (power2.out); the action cells behind it brighten with the drag.
moworks.titleVi: Vuốt dòng lộ nút thao tác
